title: 'Flash cards: RC filter'

:::: {.flashcard #card-rc-filter-001}
What is the cut-off frequency of an RC low-pass, with $R$ and $C$?

::: back
$$
f_\mathrm{g} = \frac{1}{2\pi RC}
$$

The output has dropped to $1/\sqrt{2}$ of the input there.
:::
::::

:::: {.flashcard #card-rc-filter-002}
Name the two parts of an RC low-pass.

::: back
A **resistor** in the series branch and a **capacitor** in the shunt branch.
:::
::::
